input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production portrait mobile slot-game cabinet backdrop for Cocos Creator, designed to sit behind live reel and button overlays
Primary request: create one original, complete free-standing wealth-themed slot machine cabinet with the warm inviting proportions and playful rounded luxury of a premium vintage dessert arcade machine, but replace every candy motif with pearls, blank gold coins, rubies, emeralds and diamonds
Scene/backdrop: softly lit champagne boutique arcade; a single centered cabinet with an oversized blank burgundy marquee plaque ringed by warm round bulbs, a small blank balance capsule, one very large empty cream reel aperture, a narrow blank win-message plaque, a sculpted control deck with a central round gold button recess and two smaller side control recesses, and a rich burgundy lower pedestal with a pearl medallion; restrained pearl strings, coin stacks and gemstones decorate the frame and side shelves
Style/medium: high-end polished 3D mobile slot game key art, shippable commercial game asset, friendly light luxury, tactile toy-like cabinet, rounded art-deco and patisserie-inspired curves without any food or candy
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, perfectly front-facing and symmetrical, cabinet occupies the central 82 percent width and nearly full height, all critical details inside the center safe area; large clean reel opening centered in the upper-middle with enough width for either five columns or a 3x3 game; distinct control deck and substantial lower cabinet body; background remains secondary and softly blurred
Lighting/mood: warm diffused boutique daylight, animated-marquee feeling, dense but controlled golden highlights, pearl iridescence and gemstone sparkle, celebratory and highly attractive, soft rather than solemn
Color palette: champagne gold, rose gold, pearl ivory, cream enamel and warm burgundy lacquer, with small emerald, ruby and diamond accents; no black-dominant areas
Materials/textures: glossy burgundy lacquer, satin and polished gold, ivory enamel, carved filigree, nacreous pearls, cut gemstones, glass bulbs
Text: none
Constraints: blank marquee, blank balance capsule, empty reel aperture with a pale ivory interior and no symbols, blank win plaque, visually clear control zones; no characters; no logos; no watermark; no letters; no numbers; no currency marks; no candy; no cakes; no chocolate; no recognizable brand or copied ornament; original design only
Avoid: royal palace grandeur, throne, temple, cathedral, dark casino, black-and-gold severity, neon nightclub, flat vector art, sci-fi, oversized loose objects in the reel opening, text-like markings, cluttered UI
